text:
clara: Quick request: can we create 'impact-by-decision' one-liners for self-reviews? Focus on decisions not tasks.
omar: yes — short pattern: Decision / Reason -> Outcome (one line).
jena: add a second line for metric when available and a one-line ask.
mike: include hiring ops acceptance criteria for backfills so recruiters can close faster.
hr-bot: Reminder: self-review window opens next Mon; calibration invites sent.

clara: Draft patterns (pasteable):

Decision format (single line):
- Decided to [action] because [reason] -> Result: [outcome / user or biz impact].

Metric line (optional):
- Metric: [metric] from [baseline] to [current] (delta [+/-%]).

Ask (single line):
- Ask: Need [support/headcount/priority] to [next step]; owner: @NAME, ETA: [date].

Hiring ops acceptance (paste in job brief):
- Acceptance criteria: 1) Must cover [ownership area]; 2) Able to onboard in [timeframe]; 3) Key skill: [skill].

Benefits quick-pointer (paste in comp/headcount asks):
- Benefits: Attach business case + headcount impact + org chart; people-ops@redwood responds in 3-5 business days.

Manager calibration one-liners:
- Impact: "Made a clear decision on X -> delivered measurable improvement on Y."
- Development: "Solid execution; recommend coaching on stakeholder communication."

jena: I like adding 2 sanitized examples for eng and pm before publishing.
omar: i'll collect examples and send tonight.
clara: I'll publish as 'impact-by-decision' snippet in the handbook and link in the review form. Last chance to edit here. :sparkles:
